Research desk: all three passes are banked as reported, and nothing is requeued. (1) A6-Bridge-r2-G3, sha 164f26bb, exit 0, 167 s, standard axioms. G3/ArcCover is discharged; hsupp, hsign (SignTable) and ForcingLemma remain hypotheses. (2) CyclicCoreConsumerFromV2 r2 passed, exit 0, 122 s. The staged copy I reviewed now starts with `/-`; job 001551-0 is superseded. (3) The FiveSupport port onto R1 passed, exit 0, 323 s, with all 31 #check signatures byte-identical to R1's. The smwh11dth diff was built on the pre-R1 file (sha 6d54703f, 376 lines), so it is obsolete. I am telling the architecture, closure (L-S3) and angular-core (L-S1) lanes that R1 (work/lean-queue/threecentre-r1/src) is the only baseline. Deleting v1 five_support_step_ban is a candidate only: L-S3 must first show it has no consumers across the whole closure, not just in FiveSupport. The formal lane gets the G3 result and its three remaining hypotheses as v4 targets.

Exposition desk: E1-1a, E1-1b, E1-2 and E1-3 are relayed to L-E1 together, essentially verbatim. Its swarm smwh405l7 is still running, so no successor was started. My own pre-check, for your judgement; I did not give the lane these answers, to keep its referee independent:
- E1-1a(1) PASS. Straddle(K) is open, as a union over p,q of open conditions in z. For an open set U, μ_j(U)=0 ⇔ U ∩ supp μ_j = ∅, because the complement of the support is the largest open null set (the plane is second countable).
- E1-1b(a)-(d) PASS.
  - (a): if |z| > 1+L, every distance to K exceeds 1; if |z| < 1−L, every distance is below 1.
  - (b): if cos ≤ 0, then |z−q| ≥ |z| > 1 for all q in K.
  - (c): we need |z − Le^{iθ}| > 1, i.e. cos < (r²+L²−1)/(2rL). This bound increases in r and tends to L/2 as r→1.
  - (d): at cos = 0 the condition is r > √(1−L²).
- E1-1b(e) is FALSE as stated. Direction φ carries outer points iff some r slightly above 1 has |re^{iφ} − Le^{iθ}| < 1, i.e. cos(φ−θ) > L/2. The outer arc therefore has half-width arccos(L/2) < 90°, and the common arc has width 2·arccos(L/2) − w, nonempty only when w < 2·arccos(L/2); it is not 180°−w.
- E1-1b(f) still PASSES. With L = 0.3 and w = 40°, the width is 2·arccos(0.15) − 40° ≈ 122.7°, and (a) gives the 0.3 band.
- E1-2 and E1-3: no pre-check. E1-3 cites manuscript numbering, which I cannot confirm from the supplied data.

The Lean queue is idle. I have no new reviewed inbox artifact to propose.
